Counting letter relabelings and center swap gives q(q-1)(q-2)/2 unordered n5 extremizers. Binary n6 and ternary n5 explicit six-witnesses extend to all n by common-prefix LCS identity. Thus exact eventual six and first attainment lengths proven without inferring infinity from finite enumeration.
